$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-permission).

Tool.$why: Figma's frame hugs its content; in code it fills the card so long lines wrap.

Body.$why: Figma's Body is an auto-layout frame with one child, so its gap means nothing; the code's blockquote is a block.

Scope.$why: Figma draws the rule above the section as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as the section's top border, so it is 1 px taller (the card's size is compared).

It can.$why: Figma's frame hugs its content; in code it fills the card so long lines wrap.

Item.$why: Figma's frame hugs its content; in code it fills the card so long lines wrap.

Files.$why: Figma draws the rule above the section as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as the section's top border, so it is 1 px taller (the card's size is compared).

Duration.$why: Figma draws the rule above the section as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as the section's top border, so it is 1 px taller (the card's size is compared). Figma's Duration holds one frame (For how long) whose 6 px gap the code puts on the section itself.

For how long.$why: Figma's inner frame; in code the section itself stacks the heading, the options and the note 6 px apart (that gap is compared).

Options.$why: The group hugs three text labels, whose widths follow the font (Figma's Inter and the web font differ by about a pixel over the three); the height and the 4 px gap are compared.
